entities.summary: John James Duncan Jr. is an American politician who served as the U.S. representative for Tennessee's 2nd congressional district from 1988 to 2019. An attorney, former Criminal Court judge, and former long serving member of the Army National Guard, published author and newspaper columnist. He is a member of the Republican Party. Jimmy Duncan was a legal figures from Lebanon (b. 1947-07-21, Lebanon). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
